_README: Color-pair archetypes for synergy scoring. Update when the set rotates.
Keys are sorted color pairs: BG, BR, BW, GR, GU, GW, RU, RW, UB, UW.
name           - human-readable archetype name (used in breakdown text)
themes         - list of substrings searched against oracle text + keywords
creature_types - list of subtypes that count as on-archetype
Cards matching either the creature_types OR any of the themes get a
synergy bonus when your pool's top 2 colors match this entry's key.
Filled in for Secrets of Strixhaven (2026) based on the published
archetype guides. Each Strixhaven college has its own keyword mechanic;
the themes here are the substrings that show up in those mechanics'
rules text, plus tribal hints and theme keywords.
